verdict.rationale: Omarchy is an Arch-based Linux distribution, so extended security update coverage is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions an extended-support or long-term security update program. It covers only adjacent security items such as mandatory disk encryption, the default firewall and automatic snapshots, none of which extend update coverage.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can enable extended years of security update coverage on my installation
